6:125.text: And whomsoever Allâh wills to guide, He opens his breast to Islâm; and whomsoever He wills to send astray, He makes his breast closed and constricted, as if he is climbing up to the sky. Thus Allâh puts the wrath on those who believe not.

6:126.text: And this is the Path of your Lord
leading Straight. We have detailed Our Revelations for a people who take heed.

6:127.text: For them will be the home of peace
with their Lord. And He will be their Walî
because of what they used to do.

6:128.text: And on the Day when He will gather them
: "O you assembly of jinn! Many did you mislead of men," and their Auliyâ’

amongst men will say: "Our Lord! We benefited one from the other, but now we have reached our appointed term which You did appoint for us." He will say: "The Fire be your dwelling-place, you will dwell therein forever, except as Allâh may will. Certainly your Lord is All-Wise, All-Knowing."

6:129.text: And thus We do make the Zâlimûn
, because of that which they used to earn.

6:130.text: O you assembly of jinn and mankind! "Did not there come to you Messengers from amongst you, reciting unto you My Verses and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say: "We bear witness against ourselves." It was the life of this world that deceived them. And they will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.

6:131.text: This is because your Lord would not destroy the
(i.e. associating others in worship along with Allâh)
